under.regimeSays: per the receiving body's own clock, which is the one anything it does with the momentum is timed by - so the lattice-rate arrival is divided by how slowly that clock runs

cites.title: the binomial theorem
cites.says: (x - 1)^n = x^n - n·x^(n-1) + ... , so subtracting a degree-n polynomial from its own shift by one cancels the leading term and leaves degree n-1

probes.asks: what are this lattice's own numbers - how many ways out of a point, how many charges a pulse lets go, how long a turn takes?
probes.found: fcc-12: D = 3, DEG = 12, SHEET = 6, CYCLE = 6 - counts, not measurements

measured.name: D
measured.note: how many dimensions fcc-12 has

measured.name: DEG
measured.note: the ways out of a point on fcc-12 - the exits it has, counted

measured.name: SHEET
measured.note: the exits with no component along the pulsing axis, which is what a source emits over. NOT DEG, which is 12

measured.name: CYCLE
measured.note: how many steps go round the ring of a turn on fcc-12

measured.name: slice
measured.note: a turn sweeps a PLANE, and a plane needs two dimensions - so what a turn lives in is min(D, 2), which is 2 here and stops growing at 2 however many dimensions are added

measured.name: \bar{c}
measured.note: a step's worth of lean is what one annihilation buys a path, and a step is \bar{c} - one cell a tick, the lattice's own speed. Its value in those units is one, which is a statement about the units and not about the quantity

probes.asks: when the medium carries something, does it make any more of it, or lose any of it, on the way?
probes.found: transport conserves exactly what it carries - 1250 rays, unchanged over 6 ticks (1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250), with EMISSION, CREATION, ANNIHILATION, TRANSPORT set aside - and it carries by stepping along the lattice's exits

measured.name: rays in the world, tick by tick
measured.note: 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250 over 6 ticks of transport alone on fcc-12, box 9, wrapped so nothing can leave. Whole numbers, so this is exact rather than close

measured.name: rules set aside to ask this
measured.note: kept MOVEMENT and ARRIVAL; set aside EMISSION, CREATION, ANNIHILATION, TRANSPORT

measured.name: how far one ray has got, tick by tick
measured.note: 2, 4, 6, 8 in lattice units after 1, 2, 3, 4 ticks - it advances by steps and cannot appear anywhere it has not stepped to

probes.asks: a structure gets one action a tick. What does spending it on moving do to the clock it would otherwise have been walking?
probes.found: G spends one action a tick on moving OR on its own clock and not both - and because a ray moves at one cell a tick whatever happens, those are two directions of one fixed rate rather than two shares of an amount. So they add as squares and the clock runs at sqrt(1 - β²): the Lorentz factor, out of the budget rather than beside it

measured.name: rules that move a structure
measured.note: TRANSPORT, over "World"

measured.name: the theory carries an upkeep
measured.note: G declares `upkeep` - what one period of a structure's own clock costs - and spends the tick on it BEFORE moving, which is what "not both" means

steps.because: so the force is the one between bodies at rest, times what retardation does to what arrives, quoted per the receiving body's own clock, which is the one anything it does with the momentum is timed by - so the lattice-rate arrival is divided by how slowly that clock runs. The first order cancels between the two retarded branches and the square survives; the clock then contributes its own half a square, out of the budget rule

you do not know which side of the source you are on, so both branches are there at half weight each. This is the same ignorance matter.wavelength weighs, and it is not a knob: half is what two possibilities with nothing to tell them apart come to. Weighted so, the two first-order terms are equal and opposite and cancel - which is why the ignorant answer is quadratic and isotropic
retardation is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1/2·ahead + 1/2·behind, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
how much a lattice tick is worth in the receiver's own ticks is one over how fast that clock runs - the same quantity the budget gave, to the opposite power

a ray moves at exactly one cell a tick and never slower, so what a structure varies is not how fast its constituents go but WHICH WAY - motion that walks its own graph gets nowhere, motion that carries it across the lattice does. Two components of a rate whose magnitude is fixed, so they add as squares rather than as shares: what is left for the clock is 1 - β²

probes.asks: what are this lattice's own numbers - how many ways out of a point, how many charges a pulse lets go, how long a turn takes?
probes.found: fcc-12: D = 3, DEG = 12, SHEET = 6, CYCLE = 6 - counts, not measurements

measured.name: D
measured.note: how many dimensions fcc-12 has

measured.name: DEG
measured.note: the ways out of a point on fcc-12 - the exits it has, counted

measured.name: SHEET
measured.note: the exits with no component along the pulsing axis, which is what a source emits over. NOT DEG, which is 12

measured.name: CYCLE
measured.note: how many steps go round the ring of a turn on fcc-12

measured.name: slice
measured.note: a turn sweeps a PLANE, and a plane needs two dimensions - so what a turn lives in is min(D, 2), which is 2 here and stops growing at 2 however many dimensions are added

measured.name: \bar{c}
measured.note: a step's worth of lean is what one annihilation buys a path, and a step is \bar{c} - one cell a tick, the lattice's own speed. Its value in those units is one, which is a statement about the units and not about the quantity

probes.asks: when the medium carries something, does it make any more of it, or lose any of it, on the way?
probes.found: transport conserves exactly what it carries - 1250 rays, unchanged over 6 ticks (1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250), with EMISSION, CREATION, ANNIHILATION, TRANSPORT set aside - and it carries by stepping along the lattice's exits

measured.name: rays in the world, tick by tick
measured.note: 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250, 1250 over 6 ticks of transport alone on fcc-12, box 9, wrapped so nothing can leave. Whole numbers, so this is exact rather than close

measured.name: rules set aside to ask this
measured.note: kept MOVEMENT and ARRIVAL; set aside EMISSION, CREATION, ANNIHILATION, TRANSPORT

measured.name: how far one ray has got, tick by tick
measured.note: 2, 4, 6, 8 in lattice units after 1, 2, 3, 4 ticks - it advances by steps and cannot appear anywhere it has not stepped to

probes.asks: a structure gets one action a tick. What does spending it on moving do to the clock it would otherwise have been walking?
probes.found: G spends one action a tick on moving OR on its own clock and not both - and because a ray moves at one cell a tick whatever happens, those are two directions of one fixed rate rather than two shares of an amount. So they add as squares and the clock runs at sqrt(1 - β²): the Lorentz factor, out of the budget rather than beside it

measured.name: rules that move a structure
measured.note: TRANSPORT, over "World"

measured.name: the theory carries an upkeep
measured.note: G declares `upkeep` - what one period of a structure's own clock costs - and spends the tick on it BEFORE moving, which is what "not both" means

steps.because: so the force is the one between bodies at rest, times what retardation does to what arrives, quoted per the emitting body's clock, which sets how often it pulses - a slowed source emits less often, so less arrives per lattice tick. The first order cancels between the two retarded branches and the square survives; the clock then contributes half a square the other way, out of the budget rule

you do not know which side of the source you are on, so both branches are there at half weight each. This is the same ignorance matter.wavelength weighs, and it is not a knob: half is what two possibilities with nothing to tell them apart come to. Weighted so, the two first-order terms are equal and opposite and cancel - which is why the ignorant answer is quadratic and isotropic
retardation is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1/2·ahead + 1/2·behind, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out

and the clock is the size of that remaining component, which is its root - so a moving thing ticks at sqrt(1 - β²). That is the Lorentz factor inverted, out of the constituents all moving at one speed and nothing else: the more of its tick a structure spends updating itself the less it moves, which is what time dilation IS here rather than something imposed alongside it

measured.name: the theory carries an upkeep
measured.note: G declares `upkeep` - what one period of a structure's own clock costs - and spends the tick on it BEFORE moving, which is what "not both" means

steps.because: a ray moves at exactly one cell a tick and never slower, so what a structure varies is not how fast its constituents go but WHICH WAY - motion that walks its own graph gets nowhere, motion that carries it across the lattice does. Two components of a rate whose magnitude is fixed, so they add as squares rather than as shares: what is left for the clock is 1 - β²

measured.name: the theory carries an upkeep
measured.note: G declares `upkeep` - what one period of a structure's own clock costs - and spends the tick on it BEFORE moving, which is what "not both" means

steps.because: left is 1 - spent^{2}, which is one plus -spent^{2}. Raised to 1/2 that is [[binomial]] in -spent^{2}, kept to first order
clock is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1 - 1/2·spent^{2}, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
what arrives from the compressed branch goes as one over that
over the delay the source has moved, so the branch that set out ahead of the motion left from closer than R and arrives compressed - by one less the fraction of a cell a tick it is going
1-β is 1 - β_{v}, which is one plus -β_{v}. Raised to -1 that is [[binomial]] in -β_{v}, kept to second order
ahead is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1 + β_{v} + β_{v}^{2}, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
and from the stretched one, one over the other
and the branch behind left from further away and arrives stretched by the same amount the other way
1+β is 1 + β_{v}, which is one plus β_{v}. Raised to -1 that is [[binomial]] in β_{v}, kept to second order
behind is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1 - β_{v} + β_{v}^{2}, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out

a structure gets one action a tick and crossing a cell costs the whole of it, so a thing going at a fraction β of a cell a tick spends that fraction of its actions on moving. Read off TRANSPORT, which takes the upkeep before it moves anything

probes.asks: a structure gets one action a tick. What does spending it on moving do to the clock it would otherwise have been walking?

a ray moves at exactly one cell a tick and never slower, so what a structure varies is not how fast its constituents go but WHICH WAY - motion that walks its own graph gets nowhere, motion that carries it across the lattice does. probes.asks: a structure gets one action a tick. What does spending it on moving do to the clock it would otherwise have been walking?
probes.found: G^XOR spends one action a tick on moving OR on its own clock and not both - and because a ray moves at one cell a tick whatever happens, those are two directions of one fixed rate rather than two shares of an amount. So they add as squares and the clock runs at sqrt(1 - β²): the Lorentz factor, out of the budget rather than beside it

measured.name: the theory carries an upkeep

steps.because: so the force is the one between bodies at rest, times what retardation does to what arrives, quoted per the receiving body's own clock, which is the one anything it does with the momentum is timed by - so the lattice-rate arrival is divided by how slowly that clock runs. The first order cancels between the two retarded branches and the square survives; the clock then contributes its own half a square, out of the budget rule

you do not know which side of the source you are on, so both branches are there at half weight each. This is the same ignorance matter.wavelength weighs, and it is not a knob: half is what two possibilities with nothing to tell them apart come to. Weighted so, the two first-order terms are equal and opposite and cancel - which is why the ignorant answer is quadratic and isotropic
retardation is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1/2·ahead + 1/2·behind, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
how much a lattice tick is worth in the receiver's own ticks is one over how fast that clock runs - the same quantity the budget gave, to the opposite power

a ray moves at exactly one cell a tick and never slower, so what a structure varies is not how fast its constituents go but WHICH WAY - motion that walks its own graph gets nowhere, motion that carries it across the lattice does. Two components of a rate whose magnitude is fixed, so they add as squares rather than as shares: what is left for the clock is 1 - β²

probes.asks: a structure gets one action a tick. What does spending it on moving do to the clock it would otherwise have been walking?
probes.found: G^XOR spends one action a tick on moving OR on its own clock and not both - and because a ray moves at one cell a tick whatever happens, those are two directions of one fixed rate rather than two shares of an amount. So they add as squares and the clock runs at sqrt(1 - β²): the Lorentz factor, out of the budget rather than beside it

measured.name: the theory carries an upkeep

steps.because: so the force is the one between bodies at rest, times what retardation does to what arrives, quoted per the emitting body's clock, which sets how often it pulses - a slowed source emits less often, so less arrives per lattice tick. you do not know which side of the source you are on, so both branches are there at half weight each. retardation is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1/2·ahead + 1/2·behind, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out

and the clock is the size of that remaining component, which is its root - so a moving thing ticks at sqrt(1 - β²). probes.asks: a structure gets one action a tick. What does spending it on moving do to the clock it would otherwise have been walking?
probes.found: G^XOR*2 spends one action a tick on moving OR on its own clock and not both - and because a ray moves at one cell a tick whatever happens, those are two directions of one fixed rate rather than two shares of an amount. So they add as squares and the clock runs at sqrt(1 - β²): the Lorentz factor, out of the budget rather than beside it

measured.name: the theory carries an upkeep

steps.because: so the force is the one between bodies at rest, times what retardation does to what arrives, quoted per the receiving body's own clock, which is the one anything it does with the momentum is timed by - so the lattice-rate arrival is divided by how slowly that clock runs. The first order cancels between the two retarded branches and the square survives; the clock then contributes its own half a square, out of the budget rule

you do not know which side of the source you are on, so both branches are there at half weight each. This is the same ignorance matter.wavelength weighs, and it is not a knob: half is what two possibilities with nothing to tell them apart come to. Weighted so, the two first-order terms are equal and opposite and cancel - which is why the ignorant answer is quadratic and isotropic
retardation is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1/2·ahead + 1/2·behind, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
how much a lattice tick is worth in the receiver's own ticks is one over how fast that clock runs - the same quantity the budget gave, to the opposite power

a ray moves at exactly one cell a tick and never slower, so what a structure varies is not how fast its constituents go but WHICH WAY - motion that walks its own graph gets nowhere, motion that carries it across the lattice does. probes.asks: a structure gets one action a tick. What does spending it on moving do to the clock it would otherwise have been walking?
probes.found: G^XOR*2 spends one action a tick on moving OR on its own clock and not both - and because a ray moves at one cell a tick whatever happens, those are two directions of one fixed rate rather than two shares of an amount. So they add as squares and the clock runs at sqrt(1 - β²): the Lorentz factor, out of the budget rather than beside it

steps.because: so the force is the one between bodies at rest, times what retardation does to what arrives, quoted per the emitting body's clock, which sets how often it pulses - a slowed source emits less often, so less arrives per lattice tick. you do not know which side of the source you are on, so both branches are there at half weight each. This is the same ignorance matter.wavelength weighs, and it is not a knob: half is what two possibilities with nothing to tell them apart come to. Weighted so, the two first-order terms are equal and opposite and cancel - which is why the ignorant answer is quadratic and isotropic
retardation is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1/2·ahead + 1/2·behind, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out

and the clock is the size of that remaining component, which is its root - so a moving thing ticks at sqrt(1 - β²). That is the Lorentz factor inverted, out of the constituents all moving at one speed and nothing else: the more of its tick a structure spends updating itself the less it moves, which is what time dilation IS here rather than something imposed alongside it

measured.name: the theory carries an upkeep

steps.because: a ray moves at exactly one cell a tick and never slower, so what a structure varies is not how fast its constituents go but WHICH WAY - motion that walks its own graph gets nowhere, motion that carries it across the lattice does. Two components of a rate whose magnitude is fixed, so they add as squares rather than as shares: what is left for the clock is 1 - β²

steps.because: so the force is the one between bodies at rest, times what retardation does to what arrives, quoted per the receiver's clock, knowing the source is going AWAY - only the stretched branch, and the first order survives with the other sign. The first order cancels between the two retarded branches and the square survives; the clock then contributes its own half a square, out of the budget rule

you KNOW the source is receding, so only that branch is weighed. The cancellation that made the ignorant case quadratic does not happen, and what is left carries a term LINEAR in the speed - smaller than the isotropic answer by about b, which at any ordinary speed dwarfs the b^{2} it sits on
retardation is not a primitive of this theory - it is behind, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
how much a lattice tick is worth in the receiver's own ticks is one over how fast that clock runs - the same quantity the budget gave, to the opposite power

a ray moves at exactly one cell a tick and never slower, so what a structure varies is not how fast its constituents go but WHICH WAY - motion that walks its own graph gets nowhere, motion that carries it across the lattice does. Two components of a rate whose magnitude is fixed, so they add as squares rather than as shares: what is left for the clock is 1 - β²
